description: A `class` declaration written directly in a `<program>` body (after markup, no `${ }` wrapper) fires E-CLASS-NOT-IN-SCRML — the same code it gets inside `${ }` — instead of shipping as page text (S441).
rationale: SPEC §7.2.1 (constructs "rejected at the parse layer, each under a code of the E-*-NOT-IN-SCRML family") + §40.8 (a <program>/<page> body parses in default-logic mode) + the S439 #2 grammar-head lift precedent. Pre-S441 the construct leading a body-top text run shipped as PAGE TEXT at exit 0; it now reaches the logic parser by its brace-delimited grammar head and gets the same code it gets inside ${ }.
